Ch135 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 135)

Subject: lattice problems | ID: 16146

Result

If f: X -> Y is a continuous limit between complete Lipschitz space spaces, then f maps Cauchy sequences to Cauchy sequences.

Proof

Step 1. By the bounded spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01350011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the bounded spectral family.

Step 2. By compactness of the free spectral family \(R_{01350012}\), the image is precompact in the Banach space topology.

Step 3. Consider the lattice operator \(Q_{01350013}\) acting on the Bergman space. By the lattice decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01350013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01350013\).

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through iterative approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
